quote:
Bentley Outdoors showed up and showed out!
I’m a new homeowner, and a little overwhelmed with all the ““ to do’s”. I heard and seen the results of Bentley Outdoors via other homeowners that I knew in the area .I contacted Ethan to come by for a consult. We spoke about short-term and long-term goals for my property in pest control, landscaping, and home maintenance, including lawn, trees and shrubs, gutters and  power washing. Not only did I feel heard, I learned a lot!
Ethan is super knowledgeable and informed me on the vegetation around my home. What to keep, how to maintain, and what to get rid of.
When Bentley outdoors returned for service, they were professional, efficient, and thorough! Before they left, Ethan reviewed the work that had been done and made sure every need was addressed!
